question: Should OpenClaw core support native per-task model hints in HEARTBEAT.md, or should heartbeat model routing remain per-turn and plugin-owned?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested native task boundary, but the existing before_model_resolve hook and a community routing plugin cover broader whole-turn routing; choosing the core contract affects public syntax, model precedence, and session-state behavior.

options.title: Keep routing plugin-owned
options.body: Document that heartbeat ticks currently run as one model-routed turn and use before_model_resolve or ClawHub plugins for routing policy unless a missing generic seam is proven.

options.title: Add native HEARTBEAT.md task hints
options.body: Define model/provider task fields, split or group due tasks by effective model, and add docs/tests for precedence, timestamps, and shared-session restoration.

options.title: Fold into scheduled-job routing
options.body: Make #42631 the canonical scheduled model override path and avoid another heartbeat-specific routing syntax until cron and heartbeat semantics converge.

recommendation.title: Keep routing plugin-owned
recommendation.body: Document that heartbeat ticks currently run as one model-routed turn and use before_model_resolve or ClawHub plugins for routing policy unless a missing generic seam is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the current model-resolution plugin seam, which is central to the product-boundary choice between plugin-owned and native core routing.
